layer: Design C: synthetic control with in-space and in-time placebos - an effect estimate only where its placebos support one

spec.stamp: declared 2026-10-28, before any weight was fitted
spec.estimator: simplex-constrained least squares on the pre-treatment outcome path (quadprog), fixed objective
spec.verdict_rule: A window is `identified` only if **all three** hold: (1) its pre-fit ratio is at or below 0.10, the gate's own threshold, carried rather than re-decided; (2) the in-space rank p is at or below 0.05, i.e. the treated unit's post/pre RMSPE ratio is the largest among itself and the placebos; and (3) every in-time placebo that could be run returns a mean gap smaller in absolute value than **half** the estimated gap. Otherwise the window is `estimated_not_identified` and each failed check is named. A window the gate refused is `refused` with the gate's reason and no number. Report the gap and its placebos either way. Declared 2026-10-28, before any weight was fitted.
refusals: no standard error, confidence interval or p-value other than the rank p — a synthetic control has no sampling distribution
no significance claim from the pre-fit ratio alone; the ratio is a fit diagnostic, and with 99 donors it is interpolation
no per-president wording: windows are keyed by tenure id, and the artifact prints no surname
not_claimed: This is not the effect of a president. It is the gap between Nigeria's path and a weighted combination of other countries' paths after a transition.
The counterfactual is not observed. A low pre-fit ratio shows the donors can reproduce the pre-period, not that they would have reproduced the post-period without the transition.
The donor pool is countries, not Nigerian states: it cannot hold constant anything Nigeria-specific — the oil cycle, the naira, the security environment.
The windows overlap in their pre-periods and are not additive: a later window's counterfactual already contains the earlier tenures.
The pre-fit gate does not discriminate on this pool: 99 donors and 8 to 16 pre-years make the fit underdetermined, so the placebos carry the verdict.
